document.title: A Synthetic Study of Layout Parsing

content.content: A Synthetic Study of Layout Parsing
Ada Example and Bo Sample, Example University

Document understanding systems convert page images into structured text. We describe a simple pipeline that detects layout regions, orders them and recognises formulas, then evaluate it on a small benchmark of scientific articles.
